label: PF Backlog 588
title: Wire the artifact contract + project-size profile into generation (single source for the section plan)
body:
## Problem / why
Generation uses config/agent-requirements.json sections + hardcoded prompt templates; the artifact contract + profile are only used for post-hoc validation (BI-PF-1347) and the advisory outline gate (BI-PF-1372). resolve() is called WITHOUT the project profile (agent_runner.py:913, stage_runner.py:105), so the slider never bites.
## Goal & value
The resolved contract (required vs optional sections per profile + counts + size) becomes the single source for an agent's generation section plan.
## Acceptance criteria
- A new Go op artifact_contracts.generation_plan returns the agent/stage section plan for a given profile (required always; optional per profile; counts; size).
- stage_runner/agent_runner build sections from that plan (no hardcoded template list).
## Approach
Extend go/pfcore/artifact_contracts.go (reuse resolve) + thin client core/contracts.py + wire in core/orchestrator/agent_runner.py.
